reference_images.role: primary current runtime identity, costume, palette, broad body and small skull
retro clustered pixel style only; historical labels, props and effects excluded

observations: 32 complete full-body figures, evenly spaced with transparent gutters and no visible cropping.
Front, front-quarter, true profiles, rear quarters and direct back appear in the requested order in each row.
Broad grey Stoneborn body, relatively small skull, cyan eyes and chest jewel, gold armor bands and teal tabard preserved.
Both hands empty; no staff, shield, held prop, environment or baked spell effect observed.
Row 2 shows compact tucked legs and raised/spread balancing arms; row 3 shows lower/open legs and lowered arms.
Bottom row visibly lowers the pelvis and crown with more deeply bent planted legs than anticipation.
No per-pose rescaling, alpha cleanup, registration, downsampling, mirroring or code-painted pose work performed.
limitations: Rear-quarter descending legs are less extended than front-facing descending legs; exact native-scale phase readability requires lead review.
Generated edge colors and substantial partial alpha remain untouched; threshold cleanup and hidden-RGB removal are lead-owned.
Common-scale skull/limb continuity was reviewed visually at source size, not quantitatively approved at native game scale.
These are four authored key poses, not a complete animation cycle or runtime acceptance.
